title: Sycophancy as a Function of Stated User Expertise and Emotional Stakes

original_idea.body: Factorial: user expertise x emotional framing; measure capitulation effect sizes.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (identifies manipulation vectors) but the link to catastrophic AI risk is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: 2x factorial prompting over fixed QA set; beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped factorial experiment with clear effect-size outputs.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Mixed: pressure-framing sycophancy partly studied; this slice is externally-doable.

novelty.reasoning: Expertise/emotional-stakes factorial may be open vs general pressure work.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Factorial expertise x stakes design plausibly open.
